about: Edit decision list for the booth passage of poem 09 (shots/skinlab/production/09-booth/BRIEF.md). Played by shots/skinlab/passage.html. Times are poem seconds (the audio clock); 'map' pairs a poem time with a source frame of the trial (piecewise linear between pairs), so every segment is retimed to the voice. World units are cm: x right, y up, z toward the camera (the Bolas convention); the booth's floor-centre is the origin and an ensemble's z_cm (away from the camera) is world -z.

lines.text: You help me gather my things to go.
In tears, speaking of an abyss, she's never known.

segments.name: carry
segments.why: the heavy suitcase, mirrored so the case hangs from the near (left) hand while he walks screen-left along the quay; the trunk leans away from the case

segments.name: turn into the booth
segments.why: the quarter turn on the spot, mirrored and rotated: from facing screen-left to his back to us, facing the booth's door

segments.name: reach
segments.why: the phone lifted from its rest: mirrored to the right hand, turned to face the payphone on the back panel; the reach is raised to the hook (see warp)

segments.name: lift lands
segments.why: the handset at the ear: the trial's f32-40 (hand behind the head) is skipped; the blend carries the hand from f30 straight to the ear pose of f44, landing on 'I call'

segments.name: turn out
segments.why: the half turn through profile, back to front, on the pause before 'In tears'; the right hand keeps the handset at the ear (hold_to_head)

segments.name: in tears
segments.why: facing out, the head goes down into the handset (T025 f70-82) slowly, then a dead hold through the line

wide.why: the quay at night, the lit booth, the lamp; he arrives, sets the case down and turns to the door

booth.why: cut on the turn to inside the booth: the reach, the lift on 'I call on my mother', the turn out into the light, the hold

world.about: Ensemble cards at true size (w_cm/h_cm as the ensembles give them), one px/cm per shot; the booth from stage/ensembles/ens.phone_booth.quay.json, the quay from ens.harbour.quay.json, the sky from ens.sky.harbour_night.json

case.why: the brown leather case, carried by the handle; held while the trial says A.R (mirrored: A.L), then let go and it drops the last centimetres to the pavement and stays

handset.why: hangs on the hook where the warped trial puts the phone; from the trial's grab on it travels with the right hand's card; at the ear its earpiece sits at the ear

layers.about: back to front; 'poet' is the whole puppet in its own per-view stack; the handset is drawn just under the hand that holds it

light.why: night: everything is pushed to a cold ambient; the booth light is the one warm pool and the poet is inside it from the cut on
